newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to make statement on Middle East.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to make statement on Middle East.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will make a statement on the Middle East at 8:30 a.m. EDT (1230 GMT) on Sunday, a White House spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman declined to give any details on the substance of the president's remarks, which had not been scheduled.
An Israeli policeman and two Palestinians were wounded on Sunday in fresh clashes over the Jewish state's policies in Jerusalem, Israel Radio and Palestinian sources said.
Palestinians hurled stones at Israeli policemen at the reopening on Sunday of a controversial tourist tunnel in Arab East Jerusalem.
Nearly 70 people, mostly Palestinians, were killed last week in gunbattles prompted by the initial opening of the tunnel.
